mapper.select: SELECT CALENDAR_IDX, ADMIN_IDX, TITLE, EVENT_DATE, START_TIME, END_TIME, ALL_DAY, COLOR, MEMO, EVENT_TYPE, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPDATED_AT FROM ADMIN_CALENDAR_EVENT WHERE ADMIN_IDX = #{adminIdx} AND EVENT_DATE BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY EVENT_DATE ASC, NVL(START_TIME, '00:00') ASC, CALENDAR_IDX ASC

SELECT CALENDAR_IDX, ADMIN_IDX, TITLE, EVENT_DATE, START_TIME, END_TIME, ALL_DAY, COLOR, MEMO, EVENT_TYPE, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPDATED_AT FROM ADMIN_CALENDAR_EVENT WHERE CALENDAR_IDX = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_CALENDAR_EVENT ( CALENDAR_IDX, ADMIN_IDX, TITLE, EVENT_DATE, START_TIME, END_TIME, ALL_DAY, COLOR, MEMO, EVENT_TYPE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( ADMIN_CALENDAR_EVENT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{adminIdx}, #{title}, #{date}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{allDay}, #{color}, #{memo}, #{type}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE ADMIN_CALENDAR_EVENT SET TITLE = #{title}, EVENT_DATE = #{date}, START_TIME = #{startTime}, END_TIME = #{endTime}, ALL_DAY = #{allDay}, COLOR = #{color}, MEMO = #{memo}, EVENT_TYPE = #{type}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE CALENDAR_IDX = #{id} AND ADMIN_IDX = #{adminIdx}
